name: print-social-store-corner-puzzle-feed-in-blush-with-script-accents
title: 'Store Corner' blush puzzle feed with interior photos, serif quotes and script accents
whatItIs: A 3x3 Instagram grid in blush pink and white for a home store: interior photos of plants, desks and lamps, framed quote posts with serif text, stacked 'LO REM IP SUM' type, vertical script titles and thin rule lines, plus a single post shown in Instagram UI.
whatItMeans: Soft and curated; alternating photo and quote tiles make the feed feel like a calm lookbook.
techniques: Alternate photo tiles with typographic quote tiles.
Run script titles vertically along edges.
Keep one blush tone across the whole grid.
Split words across lines as a type pattern.

vocabulary.definition: A grid planned so posts look cohesive together.
A post showing only a framed quote.
